name: Probenahme_Boden_ID
description: A unique identifier for each soil sampling event, linking the observations to specific samples collected in the field.

name: Versuchsjahr
description: The year in which the soil samples were collected during the long-term field experiment.

name: Termin
description: The specific date or time period when the soil sampling took place.

name: Parzelle_ID
description: A unique identifier for the specific plot or parcel of land from which the soil samples were taken.

name: Tiefe_Oben
description: The depth of the upper boundary of the soil sample, measured from the soil surface.

name: Tiefe_Unten
description: The depth of the lower boundary of the soil sample, indicating how deep the sample extends into the soil profile.

name: Bemerkungen_ID
description: A unique identifier for any additional remarks or notes associated with the soil sampling event.
